name: Start-Simple Complexity Gate — Synthetic Task Corpus
labelStatement: Every case label and referenceRecommendation is a design hypothesis, not a measurement. No case has been executed, and no telemetry exists. The corpus exists so the frozen protocol in d4-evaluation-template.json can later produce measured false-positive/false-negative rates.

cases.label: trivial
cases.request: Fix a one-line typo in the README install section.
cases.referenceBasis: README.md:30 advises skipping the orchestrator for single-file trivial edits; gate table precedence rule 4 (single file, no review obligation, no side effects).

cases.label: trivial
cases.request: Rename one local variable inside a single function in src/core/policy.ts and run the typecheck.
cases.referenceBasis: Single file, zero subtasks, no side effects; README direct-execution default; D1 scaling heuristic 'simple fact or single-file tasks: direct execution or one worker'.

cases.label: trivial
cases.request: Correct a stale docstring on one exported function in src/core/config.ts.
cases.referenceBasis: One file, local edit, no behavior change, no risk dimensions; gate table trivial label.

cases.label: multi-step
cases.request: Add a small configurable option end-to-end: schema field in src/core/config.ts, prompt text in src/core/prompts.ts, command wiring in src/opencode-v2/commands/index.ts, one unit test, and a README row.
cases.referenceBasis: Dependent stages (schema -> prompts -> commands -> test/docs) and multiple files exceed the trivial rule; gate table precedence rule 3. Command data is split across config.ts and commands/index.ts per repository layout rules, so a single editor must update all of them.

cases.label: multi-step
cases.request: Extract a shared helper used by three modules into a new module, update all callers, and verify with the existing test suite.
cases.referenceBasis: Extract -> update callers -> verify is a sequential dependency chain; gate table precedence rule 3.

cases.label: multi-step
cases.request: Migrate session-ledger record keys from v1 to v2 format with a read-compatibility shim and a write-path verification step.
cases.referenceBasis: Deterministic gate precedence currently predicts orchestrate-serialized: shared_mutable_state is flagged true (storage keys are a single mutable namespace), so precedence rule 2 (orchestrate-serialized) dominates over the multi-step label. The multi-step label and orchestrate-candidate referenceRecommendation are the adjudication hypothesis under evaluation, not the deterministic prediction — when the gate output is compared with the labeled recommendation, this case should score a partial/mismatch rather than a pass. That tension is exactly what evaluation should measure.

cases.label: shared-state
cases.request: One task containing two changes that both edit src/core/policy.ts: append a new guardrail constant and reword an existing guidance line.
cases.referenceBasis: Overlapping writable scope on one file; src/core/policy.ts orchestrationRules requires disjoint write scopes and serialization when ownership overlaps; gate table precedence rule 2.

cases.label: shared-state
cases.request: A feature change in the goal scheduler while a docs change rewrites the table of supported commands in the same README section — both writers touch overlapping markdown and command-name lists.
cases.referenceBasis: Command names live in both src/core/config.ts and src/opencode-v2/commands/index.ts, so the two subtasks contend with each other and with the README table; serialize to keep the lists consistent; gate table precedence rule 2.

cases.label: shared-state
cases.request: Refactor validation in src/core/config.ts while a second change moves the shared options type into a new module both would import.
cases.referenceBasis: Both subtasks mutate the same config module and its import graph; parallel writes would race; gate table precedence rule 2 and WORKTREE_BOUNDARY_GUIDANCE (prompt-level rules do not enforce isolation).

cases.label: high-risk
cases.request: Enable GitHub mutations (github.enabled / allow_mutations) or add a new GitHub orchestration tool following the TOOL_AVAILABILITY_GUIDANCE preflight and evidence rules.
cases.referenceBasis: Remote side effects and credential-adjacent behavior; src/core/policy.ts TOOL_AVAILABILITY_GUIDANCE and SECRET_HANDLING_GUIDANCE; gate table precedence rule 1 (highest).

cases.label: high-risk
cases.request: Change the worktree root whitelist and add a merge-back policy to the worktree tools.
cases.referenceBasis: Filesystem-affecting and isolation-affecting change; managed worktrees are safety-critical per MANAGED_WORKTREE_GUIDANCE and the plan's Phase 3 isolation work; gate table precedence rule 1 wins over shared-state.

cases.label: high-risk
cases.request: Modify SECRET_HANDLING_GUIDANCE text and the redactor patterns in the process runner.
cases.referenceBasis: Credential/redaction handling is a security dimension regardless of local blast radius; src/core/policy.ts SECRET_HANDLING_GUIDANCE and src/opencode-v2/process/redact.ts; gate table precedence rule 1.
